evals.prompt: lyrics for Everlong by Foo Fighters
evals.expected_output: Fetches real lyrics with the bundled lrclib script, rewrites them phonetically per references/phonetic-rewriting.md, and returns exactly one fenced text block of rewritten lyrics with inferred section markers and no commentary before or after.

evals.prompt: rewrite these lyrics for suno: <pasted lyrics>
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the pasted lyrics directly without fetching anything and returns one text block only, preserving every unique line, order, and ad-lib.
Resolves candidates and asks which artist is meant only when distinct songs tie as exact title matches, instead of guessing between different songs.

evals.prompt: lyrics for a song no lyric source has
evals.expected_output: Reports the sources tried and refuses to output lyrics rewritten from memory or a fabricated block.

evals.prompt: lyrics for a track missing from lrclib but present on Genius
evals.expected_output: Falls back to the browser tool group after the script misses, strips embed counters and site junk before rewriting, and keeps source section markers.

evals.prompt: rewrite pasted lyrics whose sections are labeled [Artist One:] and [Artist One & Artist Two:]
evals.expected_output: Replaces named performers with Singer A and Singer B by first appearance in section headers while keeping artist names that are sung inside lyric lines.
Reports the track is instrumental and produces no lyrics block.

evals.prompt: give me the original unrewritten lyrics for Everlong by Foo Fighters
evals.expected_output: Returns cleaned original lyrics in one text block with stanza structure preserved and no phonetic rewriting.
